description: Inspect security-related HTTP response headers for an unfamiliar public URL before an agent trusts or recommends it. It identifies missing or weak HSTS, CSP, framing, referrer, permissions, and cross-origin headers. It reports observable configuration only and does not prove that a site is secure or vulnerability-free.

url.description: Public http(s) URL or bare domain to inspect. Bare domains are normalized to https:// automatically.

name: inspect_security_headers

accessible.description: True when the endpoint returned an HTTP response.

error.description: Validation or network error when the request could not be completed.

evidence.description: Structured header observations used to produce the verdict.

headers.description: Tracked response headers and their raw values when present.

https.description: True when the normalized URL used https.

inputUrl.description: Original user input when normalization changed it.

missingRecommended.description: Tracked headers that were not present on the response.

next_step.description: Agent-readable follow-up for sources that should be checked repeatedly.

presentCount.description: Number of tracked security headers that were present.

recommended_action.description: Suggested next step; not a security guarantee.

score.description: Heuristic security-header score based on how many tracked headers were present.

status.description: HTTP status code returned by the endpoint.

summary.description: Short human-readable explanation of the verdict.

verdict.description: Header preflight verdict based on reachability, HTTPS, and tracked header presence.

title: Security Header Inspection
